query:
insert into TestRunLogs (
                        latest_collection,
                        product_id,
                        test_run_name,
                        log_src,
                        log_hash
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4,
                        $5
                    )
                    on conflict (
                        product_id,
                        test_run_name,
                        log_src
                    ) do update
                    set
                        latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                        log_hash = excluded.log_hash
